settings.subtitle: GARAGE CONTAINMENT MATS
settings.title: CONTAIN THE ELEMENTS
settings.text: Rated for environment ranging between -40 degrees to +40 degrees Celsius. These mats are perfect for harsh winters.

A Warmup electric heated driveway system wired to a controller is designed operate automatically. As it monitors moisture, temperature, and precipitation, the controller will turn the system on to heat the surface just above freezing. Timer systems exist as well and are operated manually, but may fail to keep up with snow fall if activated late. In contrast, the Warmup WSM-252W activates based on the weather forecast, so it can preheat the slab before the snowfall.

Snow melting mat systems are composed of heating cables laid loose on re-mesh or preformed mesh mats for a faster installation. For custom layouts and curves, loose cables are recommended. For straight runs, walkways and tire-tracks, Warmups 2ft and 3ft-wide mats are the best choice.

settings.title: Innovative Insulation
settings.text: Experience the future of insulation with our Warmup Ultralight Insulation Board, made with Innovative Insulation Technology.

settings.subtitle: Multi-Layer Construction
settings.title: Maximized Insulation
settings.text:
Its unique multi-layer construction, including a strategic aluminium core, promises efficient heat conductivity, ensuring that heat is evenly and effectively distributed across your spaces.

The top-notch non-woven polypropylene and extruded polyethylene foam materials aid in minimizing heat escape into the subfloor below, significantly enhancing the energy efficiency of your underfloor heating system.
